Hi Marissa,

Thanks for today’s call. Quick recap from our side:
- Goal: validate throughput and latency for our e-commerce search assistant at 1k QPS
- Success criteria: <100ms median latency, 99th <300ms under 50 concurrent sessions, fidelity on 50 test prompts >90% accuracy
- Timeline: target 4-week POC starting July 6

Can you send proposed timeline and owners?

Thanks,
